services.desc: Looking for a Quick Molokini Rafting Adventure? This tour is for you, small group and quick. services.name: Atv Tours
services.desc: Shortly after that, you will be on your way to the Haleakala Crater, 6,500 feet above sea level. After you have taken pictures of this fabulous landscape, and of the sunrise, you will be escorted down in the van to the 6,500 ft. level. Here you begin your GUIDED Volcano bike ride. You will ride 23 miles down the mountain back to the store location in Haiku. Pickup at your resort is part of this tour. Included is all the gear you need: Chrome cruiser bikes, helmets, windbreaker outfits, and gloves. Dress in layers, as the climate will change as you come down the mountain. services.name: Helicopter Tours
services.desc: Helicopters offer a chance to see Maui in ways that few will ever experience! This tour is a helicopter to Hana and Van back out, or vice versa. A half-trip compared to a full day. Make the day trip to Hana a half-day trip by taking a luxurious Limo-Van along the Road to Hana, then fly by helicopter back to Kahului Heliport! Visit Hana in half a day! The best of the best! Take Temptation Tour’s 6 passengers’ Limo Van in one direction. See the lush rainforest jungle and many waterfalls along this windy road of Hana. Bring swimsuits as you are usually able to take a dip at the State Park or in a freshwater pool. After your van tour, you will enjoy a gourmet picnic lunch at Black Sand Beach!

services.name: Dinner Cruises
services.desc: Paragon Sailing Charters specializes in performance Sailing, Snorkel Molokini Crater, and includes a deli lunch, Beer, and Wine. Only 38 passengers, you will love this Molokini Snorkel and Sailing adventure! Avoid the crowded big boats and lie back and relax on the lounging ‘trampolines’ or have a seat in the shaded cabin. This is our “no hurries, no worries’ cruise. Simply sit back, relax, and enjoy the cruise. Includes Snorkel Gear and Instructions. Your morning Molokini snorkel excursion includes a sumptuous continental breakfast on the leisurely sail across Maalaea Bay. Enjoy the tropical landscape that makes Maui special, and during whale season (December - May), spot humpback whales

services.name: Kayak Tours
services.desc: The most exciting and intimate way to watch the whales is by kayaking. This tour also includes snorkeling. The Pali Sea Cliff Tour departs from the beach amidst swaying palm trees and heads for the remote and rugged shores and sea cliffs of an area known as the “Pali”. services.name: Piiholo Zipline
services.desc: North Shore Zipline is known as a very adventurous, fun, friendly, and safe company located on Maui. You will soar high through the canopy of giant eucalyptus trees on 7 different zip lines while overlooking Maui’s verdant North Shore. This Zipline is only 25 minutes from the Kahului airport in beautiful Haiku, Maui.
